There is no way these positive reviews are real. This game is genuinely trash. The physics are horrendous. The player character models disappear when aiming to grab objects on the floor, and with no crosshair or ability to see your hand, you just end up twerky crazy style. Achievements are fully broken on steam, and have been since August.
Physics are terrible (and not in a funny way but in a beyond frustrating way), achievements have been broken for over a month, cross-play is broken half the time. This game is not worth it.

Looking at the other glowing reviews of this game I feel like I'm doing something wrong. 

This game is frustratingly hard. I've yet to comeplete the majority of the jobs because I run out of time. Or I get stuck on the terrain because cars do no work very well on anything other than roads, and even on the road it feels like you are driving in grease, and theres no easy way to nudge a car as soon as its stuck, nor the time to do so. I completed 2 jobs so far with less than 5 seconds to spare.

The camera has the annoying habit of zooming in, hiding your character. But you need to see your hand to click buttons which makes it impossible to do if you are up against a wall. And hitting buttons corretly is really hard. It takes me a few attempts and it really shouldn't.

I bought this to play with my daughters, but neither of them can do any of the jobs and make any meaningful progress and we end up roaming around for a few minutes before finding something else to play

Just too many things that anger me for me to recommend playing this even though it is a fun game. 
1. Ground vehicles swerve too easily when turning going slightly fast 
2. Objects disappearing from vehicles upon any collision (hitting trashcans) 
3. Vehicle despawning during treasure hunt job 
4. Getting stuck after a jump as you land on your knees and you have to retry said jump/challenge 
5. Objects are basically gone if dropped into water that is deep enough to reach your head UNLESS you have certain late game items 
6. Fetch quests that require you to travel basically across the full map without encountering any of the previous issues to complete (artifacts are the most annoying) 
7. Unlocking pets only to find out they require you to buy them to even use it and they are expensive 
8. Money from jobs have to be deposited into ATMs but certain jobs ruin the effort (farm harvesting) 
9. Game crashes doing certain jobs repeatedly (newspaper delivery) 
10. Objects disappearing after your character falls from too high of a height and lands forwards 
11. Being unable to get out of stun unless you have hit the ground 
12. Clothing items once unlocked, don't list the name so you have to guess by appearance when trying for clothing sets  
13. Unable to customise the house even though it's a big milestone 
14. The direction you are going on the map isn't clear till you have moved a fair bit even though there is a navigation system 
15. Helicopter doors don't close and are purely a

Maybe I should have been able to tell, but this is a children's game and that wasn't obvious from the store page. It's not bad for what it is, but if you're not a young child this won't resonate with you, and you'll be out $25

Wobbly physics is fun, but quests are deliberately too difficult.

Great open world to mess around in. My kid was in stitches as we stole granny's furniture and dumped it in the swimming pool. And crashing planes, yeeting cows - spent hours.

But actual jobs and missions are horrendous: unnecessarily frustrating, with VERY low rewards.

	- Some missions are physically impossible: travel the entire map and back in 3 minutes to rescue someone??
	- Sewer jumping puzzle is too difficult
	- Bank vault, cop with torch can see you even if you're behind him
	- Taxi, fire, ambulance missions don't add route to satnav. And destinations are so hard to spot on the map. Wasted half your time before you even set off.
	- Dancing event is way too long - and missed squares count double than hit squares.
	- Racing tracks are way too long.
	- The flying cow sunk and didn't respawn. Couldn't be bothered to find the island again on next login.
	- Mining and others COULD be fun if they weren't against a timer

Just frustrating little game designs on every single job. It's not even the physics - that at least is fun!

My little lad loves this - just some good clean fun!

Do NOT however think for a second you'll have the patience for completion.  

Grinding money in this game is a sickening level of time-sink in and of itself (which I simply cheated to solve). 
Then without outright clicking a "win all objectives cheat" button to complete the game for you, the collectables and unlocks are fun until one mechanic - Artifact treasure hunting.  

Something like half of the treasure in the game has to dug up in treasure hunts - which are LONG.  You can speed this up with co-ordination between 2 players (good look co-ordinating that well with a 4 year old...).  I opted to cheat - increase speed by factor of 6, unlimited super jetpack, unlimited money (as they got 75 each), never knock yourself out etc - Basically completing these treasure hunts in a couple of minutes each.   I've spent every waking ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ moment for weeks doing this ♥♥♥♥, probably 20 hours now (which would translate to 100 hours on Switch or PS5 where you cannot cheat) just for my kid to be able to get one big unlock - but ♥♥♥♥ me the RNG is infurating and I'm still not done with it!    It's as bad as Old School Runescape for RNG time sinks.  Please for my sanitys sake, please put in a mechanic that guarantees an artefact every chest.  I've had 5 caveman clubs, a sozen masks and necklaces, but can I find dinosaur poop?  ♥♥♥♥ NO.

I would love to say I like this game, there is great fun to be had, but the developers seem to want to ruin it.  The amount of sections which are just close to impossible and don't have the most simple checkpoints after doing the hard parts makes the game into something that you want to throw out of the window.  It is simply NOT FUN. 

Why put physics and jumping puzzles into a game where the whole point is that the physics are "wobbly".  Then make it so that the slightest mistake results in having to go back to the beginning of the section?  That is just bad game design and takes all the fun out of the experience.  I don't understand why the developers have not solved this problem and I can only assume they want players to get horribly frustrated as you can read on so many online forums.  If this was fixed, the game would be great, but as it isn't, I cannot recommend it.

A WARNING FOR ANYONE GETTING THIS FOR THEIR KIDS: 

There are some incredibly frustrating main quest platformers etc, and the game DOES NOT have a mechanic for making things easier or letting you off if you fail; you will have to start over from the beginning, and it'll be just as hard. 
For example, the fourth queen sewer jumping quest is timed and involves multiple phases, yet your character won't jump half the time you press the jump button and will slide off pipes that have no slime on them when you're standing in the center of it. 

This game can be absolutely awful when it comes to coding the physics sometimes. 

Would not recommend for full price, only if you get it for cheap on sale. The Devs aren't interested in the game or updating it (or fixing anything). 

Also in Co-Op, you'll often have a bug blocking progress where it only counts some acts for one of the players, but the rest of the players can't redo the thing because the item will have been changed and can't  be interacted with anymore.

DO NOT BUY.

My own opinion is that this is, without a doubt, the most stupid, boring game I have played in a long time. 

It's not objectively bad though, it does what it is trying to accomplish quite well actually. The problem I have is there isn't really an actual game per se, it's a sandbox. But without any real tools to make it engaging, nothing to mold and shape the world, to create, it really is just messing around in some world with physics. There's little mini games to do but that's it. It's friendslop, a game you play with your friends for a couple hours and never pick up again. All of this is actually fine still, if you know that's what you're getting into, it's just not worth (at the time of writing) $25.

Absolute pile of nothing.
Extremely sterile and simplistic 3D software with a working netcode.
I've got it knowing it's primarily aimed at children but hoped there'd be some fun physics activities to play with my girlfriend, however, it's just got nothing going on, with a soulless and dead, sterile atmosphere. 

To clarify, the game isn't even really "multiplayer" as in none of the activities have any true multiplayer designs. Half of them are just tasks you do independently in the same play space, 100% of it designed for solo gameplay, and when I say "designed" I mean "scripted up in an afternoon" because it's all the most basic "video game" activities. 

I was thinking at first this might be something to give your 5 year old to play, but honestly, if you have a kid, just sit them in front of the PC with a PS1 emulator running Croc or Spyro or something, because this is a "game" you give to your child if you want them to become tiny apartment dwelling bug people that drink Starbucks.
